prompt:
Rework `Catalog.search` in `shelf/catalog.py` into word search: `search(text, *, tag=None)`.

Split `text` on whitespace into words. A book matches when every word occurs, case-insensitively, as a substring of its title or of its author (different words may match different fields). Blank or all-whitespace `text` returns `[]`. When the keyword-only `tag` is given, only books whose `tags` contain it can match. Results are sorted by title (case-insensitive), ties broken by ISBN.

Keep the existing tests passing (`python -m unittest discover -s tests`).
